text: A Psalm of David. 1 O YHWH, hear my prayer; give ear to my supplications! In Your faithfulness, answer me in Your righteousness!
And do not enter into judgment with Your servant, for not anyone alive is righteous before Your face.
For the enemy has pursued my soul; he has crushed my life to the ground; he has made me dwell in darkness, like the dead of old.
So my spirit through me has grown weak, [and] within me my heart is desolate.
I remember the days of antiquity; I have meditated on all Your deeds; I muse on the work of Your hands.
I spread out my hands to You; my soul [is] like a land exhausted for You. Selah
Hurry to answer me, O YHWH; my spirit fails! Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be likened with those going down [to] the Pit.
Cause me to hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for in You do I trust; make me to know the way in which I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
Deliver me from my enemies, O YHWH; to You I have fled for refuge.
Teach me to do Your will, for You [are] my God; May Your good Spirit, lead me into the land of uprightness.
For the sake of Your name, O YHWH, revive me; in Your righteousness, bring forth my soul from distress.
And in Your loving devotion, may You cut off my enemies and destroy all afflicting my soul! For I [am] Your servant.
